plan.disposition: Phase Matrix: Mini-Plan is FEATURE-only at small and External LLM Review is medium+. This is a BUG-class measurement run at small complexity.

code.disposition: Phase Matrix: Full Code Review at small fires only if risk flags. diff_risk_recheck recomputed from the real diff: 1 file, 1 LOC, risk_flags=[], escalate.required=false. Diff is one appended JSON status line; no code changed. The doubt pass was run anyway on the DECISION and is recorded completed with 9 findings.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: The rate change is significant at p=0.009, so the race is gone. — The p-value conditions on window A's point estimate as if it were the population parameter. Fisher's exact on 2/13 vs 0/28 gives p=0.095, above threshold. Rule of three on window B alone allows up to 10.7%/run, compatible with window A's observed 15.4%. Window B does NOT exclude the old rate. ACCEPTED: statistic withdrawn, reason now says SUGGESTIVE ONLY with the recomputed 3/27=11.1% bound.
findings.suggestion: Withdraw the p-value; state the rule-of-three bound and argue qualitatively.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: Zero cards in window B means zero races in window B. — Dedup censoring is invisible and was unchecked. triage.py:167 _triage_path is worktree-relative with no main-root resolver, so the dedup scan at triage.py:527-539 sees main's log as of the branch FORK POINT. An open match returns None silently; suite_race_triage.py:156-164 records that under 'recorded', so run_test_suite.py:294 never returns rc 3. A censored run is indistinguishable from a clean one, and the f0-race:shared/tests control is a DIFFERENT dedup key so it does not cover this. ACCEPTED AND VERIFIED IN CODE. Measured impact: the trg-44f26dce dismissal reached main only at 841761cc (2026-07-28T18:45:17Z), not at the 12:05:44Z event time; restarting window B there costs exactly one run (28 to 27).
findings.suggestion: Find the commit carrying the dismissal to main; drop window-B runs forked before it.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: The 3 green rounds are faithful to the configuration that produced the reds. — They ran on Python 3.11 (suite_units.PYTHON_VERSION, pinned by #519 merged 2026-08-01T07:34Z) while both post-fix reds and ~24 of the 28 window-B runs ran on 3.13/3.12 (F0.md:59-68). The rounds are faithful to the CURRENT gate, not to the configuration being explained. Does not rescue window B either way, since the pin postdates almost all of it. ACCEPTED: caveat now stated in the dismissal reason.
findings.suggestion: State that the rounds ran py3.11 while the historical observations ran 3.12/3.13.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: '0 races' means shipwright-run behaved correctly under parallelism. — unrecorded_races() only counts RETRY_SERIAL, i.e. rc 1 WITH a junit report. INFRA-class faults (rc 1 without a report, rc 2/5, timeouts) are retried, recover, and are deliberately never tracked (F0.md:113-115); they are printed, never stored. So the claim is narrower than stated. ACCEPTED: verified from the round logs that there were ZERO retries of ANY kind in all three rounds, and the reason now makes that stronger claim instead.
findings.suggestion: Claim 'zero retries of any kind', which the logs actually support.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: Window A supplies 13 clean at-risk trials to compare against. — The denominator is not reproducible (16 finalized runs fall in the interval, not 13), and inside window A the dedup key was itself OCCUPIED for ~5.1 of 17.6 hours (trg-410ef2a6 06:19-10:07, trg-44f26dce 10:49-12:05), so roughly 8 window-A runs could not have produced an observable firing. Neither window supplies clean at-risk trials. Separately, the 50-entry retention does NOT bias A vs B (oldest-first by date; oldest retained entry predates the fix) but will age window A out. ACCEPTED: this is why the statistic is withdrawn rather than merely corrected, since per-worktree fork points are unrecoverable once branches are deleted.
findings.suggestion: Withdraw the comparison; record the run ids before retention ages window A out.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: 28 finalized runs is the count of suite executions in window B. — It counts runs that REACHED MAIN, not cards minted; abandoned runs never appear in agent_docs/iterates/, and a triage.jsonl hunk can be lost in a churn merge. Biases window B toward zero. ACCEPTED as a stated limit.
findings.suggestion: State it as a lower bound on executions, not a count of observations.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: The window boundary was chosen after seeing the data (p-hacking). — Refuted by the reviewer itself: window B's start is mechanically forced by the dedup rule (triage.py:537-539), not chosen. The reviewer instead notes the strongest evidence was MISSING: the operator's own 07-28 note on trg-44f26dce recorded the opposite prediction in writing ('the measurement will probably come back red; until then the card will return'), and window B falsified that recorded prior expectation. ACCEPTED: carried into the commit body.
findings.suggestion: Add the falsified pre-registered prediction to the record.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: 3 green rounds are meaningfully stronger than the 1 the card asked for. — Only marginally: ~6% power at the historically measured 2.1% self-contention rate, and the pre-fix baseline was 5/5 green in the same 18-unit shape. Three green rounds are worth strictly less than the five that preceded the bug being confirmed present. Demoting them was the correct judgement. AGREED, no change.
findings.suggestion: No change; the demotion was already correct.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: Dismissing loses information the project needs. — Bounded. trg-1cc5043b genuinely covers the gap, is verified-at-code, and names a viable fix path, though it is SERIAL 3/3 behind trg-d66964fe and trg-392dc923 so at least three iterates out. triage.jsonl is append-only and git-tracked, so both post-fix reds survive permanently. The dismissal destroys nothing still recoverable. ACCEPTED: the decision now rests on undiagnosability plus reversibility rather than on proven absence.
findings.suggestion: Base the dismissal on undiagnosable-until-trg-1cc5043b, not on proven absence.

external_code.disposition: Phase Matrix: External LLM review is medium+ (auto); this run is small with no risk flags.

spec.disposition: Phase Matrix: Iterate Spec is skipped at small complexity, so there is no spec for a Stage-1 spec-compliance gate to review. Diff is a single appended status line in the tracked triage store.
